text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Seiun Sky,
I spotted Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear,
Spe-chan's letting out another big sigh today.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Yeah.
Lately I feel like I've been kind of spaced out—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, go on ahead home without me!
Worried after Seiun Sky suddenly took off running, I gave chase and found her standing in front of a greengrocer's shop.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, what a delicious-looking carrot♪
The color, the shine—everything is just perfect.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's a waste not to advertise.
Let's promote carrots in a big way!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Uncle
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! You can appreciate the charm of this, eh?!
Now you've got this old man all fired up!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...All righty.
Now all that's left is to wait for Spe-chan to pass by—

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Uncle
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! Hey there, little lady!
How about a perfect carrot?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Uncle
text_block_list.text:
Look at this color, this shine, it's packed with nutrition!!
I'll even throw in a bonus if you buy right now~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...No, please don't mind me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait, no way!? Totally ignored!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
Now this really gets my blood pumping...!"

Next, as soon as they arrived at the cafe,
Seiun Sky bought three cakes and set them on the table—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, Sei-chan?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Spe-chan, perfect timing~!
Truth is, I accidentally ordered way too much cake.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Could you help me finish eating this?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh, sorry Sei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh, Spe-chan?! Where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah... Huh...? No way, it's cake...?
Seeing Seiun Sky looking as if she were about to remain frozen on the spot, I impulsively—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa?! Trainer?!
H-How long have you been standing there?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I mean... No, no, even if you say "chasing after them"...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Umm... if they're this unresponsive to their favorite food,
would going over myself even... you know?
choice_data_list: You couldn't just leave it alone, which is why you came this far, right?
You couldn't just leave it alone, which is why you came this far, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, it's the sneaky Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Sheesh.
Alright, alright, I'm coming!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*... Spe-chan, wait up~...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah... Sei-chan!?
Y-You chased after me...?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well... yeah.
Like, how should I put it~...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so sorry!!
For suddenly running off like that earlier!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Actually, right now... I'm on a wicked hard cut~!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. On a weight cut... wait, what?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Is that why you were feeling down?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I know, right~?! And on top of that, there's just so much temptation today, it's rough...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Heh, ahahahahaha!
I see now~!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Oh, is that all?
choice_data_list: The culprit behind that temptation is...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Truly~.
Spe-chan will always be Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yep, I'm just being me!!
Watching the two of them cheerfully engage in lively conversation, we made our way back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, not a word of this to anyone, okay?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Fufufu. It's a se-cret~.

On the way home after that,
the smile never left Seiun Sky's face.
